targets.expr:
{eventType="Machine",job=~"${KafkaJob}",siteName=~"${SiteName}",deliveryGroupName=~"${DeliveryGroup}",machineName=~"${MachineName}"} | json machineId = "machineId", machineName="machineName", machinePowerState = "machinePowerState", machineActualStatus="machineActualStatus", status="status", isMaintenanceMode="isMaintenanceMode", isUnregistered="isUnregistered", activeSessionCount="activeSessionCount" | machineId != ""
| label_format 
    finalState = `
      {{ if eq .status "1" }} Unregistered
      {{ else if eq .status "4" }} Failed
      {{ else if or (eq .status "3") (and (eq .status "5") (gt .isMaintenanceMode "0")) }} Maintenance
      {{ else if and (eq .status "2") (gt .activeSessionCount "0") }} Active
      {{ else if or (and (eq .status "5") (eq .isMaintenanceMode "0")) (and (eq .status "2") (eq .activeSessionCount "0")) }} Ready for Use
      {{ else }} Other
      {{end}}`

{eventType="Machine",job=~"${KafkaJob}",siteName=~"${SiteName}",deliveryGroupName=~"${DeliveryGroup}",machineName=~"${MachineName}"} | json machineId = "machineId", operatingSystem = "operatingSystem" | machineId != "" | label_format os=`
    {{ if eq .operatingSystem ""}} Unknown
    {{ else }} {{.operatingSystem}}
    {{end}}`

{eventType="Machine",job=~"${KafkaJob}",siteName=~"${SiteName}",deliveryGroupName=~"${DeliveryGroup}",machineName=~"${MachineName}"} | json machineId = "machineId", machineName="machineName", machineProvisioningType = "machineProvisioningType" | machineId != ""
| label_format 
    provType = `
      {{ if eq .machineProvisioningType "0" }} Unknown
      {{ else if eq .machineProvisioningType "1" }} MCS
      {{ else if eq .machineProvisioningType "2" }} PVS
      {{ else if eq .machineProvisioningType "3" }} Manual
      {{ else }} Unknown
      {{end}}`

max(quantile_over_time(0.95, {eventType="Machine",job=~"${KafkaJob}",siteName=~"${SiteName}",deliveryGroupName=~"${DeliveryGroup}",machineName=~"${MachineName}"} | json percentCpu = "percentCpu" | percentCpu > 0 | unwrap percentCpu [5m]))

max by (deliveryGroupName) (quantile_over_time(0.95, {eventType="Machine",job=~"${KafkaJob}",siteName=~"${SiteName}",deliveryGroupName=~"${DeliveryGroup}",machineName=~"${MachineName}"} | json percentCpu = "percentCpu" | percentCpu != "" | unwrap percentCpu [$__range]) by (deliveryGroupName))

avg by (deliveryGroupName) (avg_over_time({eventType="Machine",job=~"${KafkaJob}",siteName=~"${SiteName}",deliveryGroupName=~"${DeliveryGroup}",machineName=~"${MachineName}"} | json percentCpu = "percentCpu" | percentCpu != "" | unwrap percentCpu [$__range]) by (deliveryGroupName))

max(quantile_over_time(0.95, {eventType="Machine",job=~"${KafkaJob}",siteName=~"${SiteName}",deliveryGroupName=~"${DeliveryGroup}",machineName=~"${MachineName}"} 
| json usedMemory = "usedMemory", totalMemory="totalMemory" 
| usedMemory != "" and totalMemory!="" and usedMemory != "0.0" and totalMemory!="0.0"
| label_format 
memoryConsumption = `{{divf .usedMemory .totalMemory 0.01 }}`
| unwrap memoryConsumption [5m]))

| usedMemory != "" and totalMemory!="" and usedMemory != "0.0" and totalMemory!="0.0"
| label_format 
memoryConsumption = `{{divf .usedMemory .totalMemory 0.01 }}`
| unwrap memoryConsumption [5m]))
